title: OLD WHISKEY WATER JUGS
reason: Set of nine collectable pub water jugs and advertising pieces (Teacher's, Gold Thimble, Black Douglas, McCallum's, Kaiser Stuhl, Saltram) that is likely worth more as a group than the title suggests; makers not confirmed.
findings: Nine pieces of advertising ware, not just whisky jugs as the title says: black glazed Teacher's Scotch Whisky water jug ('in a class of its own', gilt rim); black square Gold Thimble Fine Old Scotch Whisky jug; black square 'The Black Douglas 8 Years Old Scotch Whisky' jug with a gold roundel; burgundy McCallum's jug (Perfection, partly read); cream square Kaiser Stuhl Wines jug; cream square Saltram 'Fine wine takes time' jug; a third cream square jug with no printing on the visible side and a price sticker on the handle; an ochre glazed character jug of a hatted man whose base lettering starts 'Ch' but is hidden; and an amber glass ashtray reading 'Chatelle Napoleon V.S.O.P.'. No backstamps are visible (bases not shown), so the makers (for example Wade Regicor or similar) are not confirmed.
condition: Glaze looks glossy and intact on all pieces with no chips or cracks seen; a small dark speck on the rim of one cream jug; light wear to the gilt and printing possible; ashtray looks undamaged.
rescore_note: Nine pub water jugs and an ashtray (Teacher's, Gold Thimble, Black Douglas, McCallum's, Kaiser Stuhl, Saltram). Common breweriana with makers unconfirmed and low individual value, so the top of the $30 to $80 band. General knowledge, no web check.
